verdict.rationale: Store Sync is documented as connecting a merchant's product catalog so AI agents can "discover your products" and build carts, and the agent toolkit exposes list_product and show_product_details for reading the PayPal catalog. That is a first-party product-discovery surface, but no evidence shows a machine-readable offer schema covering price, availability, variants and checkout links. Access is also form-gated and limited to US physical goods in USD, so it does not reach "any listed product or service". Missing for 10: documented offer-data fields (price, availability, variants, checkout URLs), a developer-facing catalog read API or feed spec, coverage beyond US physical goods, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
